name: RuntimeCompile
tagline: In-memory Java source code compiler for dynamic class creation and JIT bytecode execution without disk I/O.
description:
An in-memory Java compiler library enabling dynamic compilation and execution of Java source code at runtime without writing temporary files to disk. Built for sub-millisecond dynamic rule evaluation and dynamic proxy generation.

Library Features

⚡ Zero Disk I/O

Compiles Java source code directly into in-memory byte arrays using JavaCompiler API and custom MemoryFileManager.

🧠 Custom ClassLoader

Instantly load server-compiled bytecode into active JVM memory using MemoryClassLoader with parent delegation.

🔒 Thread-Safe & Fast

Concurrent execution cache for compiled class definitions to eliminate redundant compilation overhead on repeated invocations.
